title: Returning the ticket and Oliver's letter
summary: Garland meets a friend at the station and returns Oliver's ticket instead of going; Oliver wrote an angry letter.

Ed Garland, April 16, 1957, Rule 4. I said, come on. So we're going to bust them all back down there. I don't go there and tell the man. I don't tell you the ticket down yet now. I go back to the man. I say, I'm sorry. I says, the order just come for me, and I'm not going away. I says, I'd like to redeem your car, give me money back. I said, you can't give me that money back. You can't put $100 to give it back to me. I said, oh man, I'm sorry. You got your money and the receipt. I got the receipt. Well, I'm going back down there and return the ticket back. Turn the ticket, send it back to the show, and Joe wrote me a letter. He told me if it was, I never said I wouldn't want you to work with me, but if it cost one penny to send for you, I wouldn't send him. One penny, he said, I never would send it to you. Yeah, that's the way I know it.
